statements: Add percentage rollouts and per-user lists to feature flags, following the rules in the README. A flag can now carry percent, allow and deny.
isEnabled(store, name, userId) in src/flags.mjs answers by those rules. setFlag(store, flag, actor, now) in src/admin.mjs saves a flag.
setFlag refuses a percent that is not a whole number from 0 to 100, or lists that are not arrays, with HttpError 400 invalid_flag.
The new behaviour has tests in test/. Keep the change focused on what this ticket needs.
brief: Add percentage rollouts and user lists to the feature flags, as the numbered statements describe. Follow the conventions already in the code and change only what the ticket needs.
